'''House Salaktori''', or '''Salaktori Hunters Guild''', was the preeminent member house of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. Many of the most elite [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] belonged to this house.
